merges.sentence: Having AI do the work undermines learning, which comes from doing the work yourself.
merges.why: All state that outsourcing work to AI forfeits the learning that doing it provides.

merges.sentence: AI use is treated like help from a collaborator, under the collaboration policy.
merges.why: Both place AI under the same rules as human collaborators.

merges.sentence: Using AI output uncritically or without understanding leads to poor submissions and lost points.
merges.why: Both state uncritical AI use yields poor graded work.

merges.sentence: AI helps experienced coders more than novices, who may be harmed by it.
merges.why: Both state AI benefit depends on prior expertise.

merges.sentence: Detailed AI policy is given elsewhere in the course materials.
merges.why: Both point readers to the fuller AI policy in another location.

merges.sentence: AI tools are not available on quizzes and exams.
merges.why: Both state assessments are taken without AI access.
